prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate an atlas of exactly FIFTEEN distinct Wuxia/Xianxia alchemical REAGENT inventory icons. 3 equal columns by 5 equal rows on a portrait canvas ratio 3:5. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. One isolated item per cell centered at 70% size, wide empty transparent margins. Simple hand painted gouache, broad shapes, few details, tactile quiet shading, clear silhouette, muted natural colors. Objects are small dishes of mineral catalysts, resin or balm stabilizers, and bottles of liquid vehicles. Containers only where specified, no ornamental labels, writing, runes, text, numbering, characters, ground, cast shadows, borders or backgrounds. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha between and around all objects; no opaque square tiles. Consistent apparent icon scale. NOT photographs, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, no large magical glows or particles. Each object must differ in shape, container and contents, not just recolor a repeated bottle. Follow exact cell order:
Cell 1, row 1, column 1: small shallow dark ceramic bowl holding coarse white salt crystals.
Cell 2, row 1, column 2: small irregular honey resin lump resting on a folded pale leaf.
Cell 3, row 1, column 3: short round clear glass vial holding pale blue clear liquid with simple cork.
Cell 4, row 2, column 1: small stone dish containing soft pale blue white mineral powder.
Cell 5, row 2, column 2: simple small wooden cup containing glossy light amber cedar sap.
Cell 6, row 2, column 3: tall narrow ceramic bottle with a clean pale aqua glaze and dark stopper.
Cell 7, row 3, column 1: small black bowl holding soft ivory ash with a few pale bamboo charcoal fragments.
Cell 8, row 3, column 2: thick muted blue gum paste in a small low brown ceramic pot.
Cell 9, row 3, column 3: small squat clear green glass flask holding a pale mint liquid.
Cell 10, row 4, column 1: shallow bronze dish holding chunky slate blue salt grains.
Cell 11, row 4, column 2: small ivory ceramic jar open to show thick pale jade balm.
Cell 12, row 4, column 3: faceted small celadon bottle with a simple clear crystal stopper.
Cell 13, row 5, column 1: small dark mortar holding silver gray fine powder, no pestle.
Cell 14, row 5, column 2: twisted dark red amber resin chunk on a small plain wooden tray.
Cell 15, row 5, column 3: small pear shaped glass flask containing very pale sky blue fluid.
